description: Phase B source-adapter expansion (ROADMAP.md Phase B; engine/docs/sources-linguistic.md Decision §2). A reusable CLDF dump adapter (`source.type: dump`) is the shared plumbing every CLDF source below (Glottolog 107, WALS/PHOIBLE-shaped, Lexibank) rides on. Model it on the existing Getty/Pleiades dump adapters (engine/src/pinakes_engine/acquire/{getty,pleiades,wikidata_dump_adapter}.py, wired through acquire/factory.py) so a new CLDF source is a category/job spec, not new adapter code. Licence-aware: CLDF sources are CC-BY / CC-BY-SA, so the licence string must travel with each record as Getty/Pleiades already do. Scope: the engine acquire layer + a job/category spec + hermetic fixtures. Head of the Phase-B chain; depends on nothing.

userStories.title: A generic CLDF dump adapter
userStories.description: Add a reusable CLDF StructureDataset/Wordlist dump adapter registered under source.type: dump, reading CLDF CSV (tab/comma) tables and emitting canonical nodes/edges, modelled on the Getty/Pleiades dump adapters.
acceptanceCriteria: A new CLDF dump adapter in engine/src/pinakes_engine/acquire/ is registered through acquire/factory.py and reads a CLDF release (languages.csv + the parameter/value tables, tab or comma) into canonical records, driven entirely by a source spec (no per-source Python).
Each emitted record carries its licence string (CC-BY / CC-BY-SA) and source provenance, exactly as the Getty/Pleiades adapters do, so share-alike attribution travels with the data.
A hermetic test drives the adapter over a tiny in-repo CLDF fixture and asserts the canonical nodes/edges + licence are produced; `uv run --all-packages pytest engine/tests` passes.

userStories.title: Spec-driven: a new CLDF source needs no new adapter code
userStories.description: Prove the plumbing is reusable by expressing a CLDF source purely as a category/job spec that the shared adapter consumes.
acceptanceCriteria: A CLDF source is added as an engine/inputs job/category spec (source.type: dump) that the generic adapter ingests with no new adapter module, demonstrating the shared plumbing 107-109 build on.
The adapter handles a malformed/truncated record via the bad-record path (as the wikidata dump reader does) rather than aborting the run, covered by a fixture.
The engine gate is green: `uv run ruff check .` (engine) and `uv run mypy src` (engine); `.chief/verify.sh` passes and any spec JSON parses.
